title: Contents Packout & Storage Card Surcharge, Dispute Window, Goodwill and Refund Limits
content:
Desk reference figures for Contents Packout & Storage payments and credits: the credit card surcharge, the window for billing-error and duplicate-line disputes, the goodwill credit cap per job, and the time to issue an approved overpayment refund.

| Figure | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Surcharge on payments made by credit card (never debit card, ACH or check), percent | 2.95 | 2.95 | 2.95 | 2.95 | 2.95 | 2.95 |
| Days after the final invoice date within which a billing-error or duplicate-line dispute may be credited, calendar days | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Maximum total goodwill credit the desk may post on one job, USD | 50.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 400.00 | 400.00 |
| Business days (Monday-Friday excluding company holidays) to issue an overpayment refund after it is approved | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |

## Reading the table

- The card surcharge of 2.95 percent, the 60-day dispute window and the 10-business-day refund time are the same on every tier.
- The goodwill cap rises with the tier, from 50.00 on On-Site Contents Manipulation to 400.00 on High-Value Contents Packout and Commercial Contents and Records Recovery; it is a total for the job, not a figure per credit.

**Hypothetical illustration.** At a surcharge of 2 percent (not the tier figure), a credit card payment of 300.00 carries 300.00 times 2 divided by one hundred, or 6.00.
